Class QuoteBuilderController

public without sharing class QuoteBuilderController

Apex controller for the quoteBuilder LWC component. Provides methods for searching products, creating products with pricebook entries, retrieving product details, and saving quotes with their line items in a single transaction.

Group:

Methods

@AuraEnabled
public static QuoteBuilderController.ProductSearchResult createProduct(
  String productName,
  Decimal unitPrice,
  String description
)

Creates a new Product2 record with a corresponding PricebookEntry in the standard pricebook.

Parameters:
    productName – The name of the product to create.
    unitPrice – The unit price for the product.
    description – The product description.

Returns:
    ProductSearchResult: The created product details with pricing information.

private static Quote defineQuote(String quoteJson)

Deserializes the JSON quote data and constructs a Quote record with the standard pricebook, default status, and expiration date.

Parameters:
    quoteJson – JSON string containing quote field values

Returns:
    Quote: The populated Quote record ready for insertion

private static List<QuoteLineItem> defineQuoteLineItems(String lineItemsJson)

Deserializes the JSON line items data, resolves PricebookEntry records for each product, and constructs QuoteLineItem records. Throws AuraHandledException if a product has no matching pricebook entry.

Parameters:
    lineItemsJson – JSON string representing the list of line item objects

Returns:
    List<QuoteLineItem>: The populated line item records ready for insertion

private static String defineQuoteName(
  Id accountId,
  List<QuoteLineItem> items
)

Builds a quote name by looking up the account's short name and product names, then passing the summary to the Gemini AI service to generate a concise quote name.

Parameters:
    accountId – The Account Id associated with the quote
    items – The list of QuoteLineItem records to extract product names from

Returns:
    String: The AI-generated quote name, or empty string if generation fails

public static String defineQuoteName(String summary)

Sends a summary string to the Gemini AI service to generate a concise quote name. Uses the GEMINI_QUOTE_NAME_PROMPT code setting as the prompt template, replacing the {0} placeholder with the provided summary.

Parameters:
    summary – The account and product summary to include in the AI prompt

Returns:
    String: The AI-generated quote name, or null if the request fails

@AuraEnabled(cacheable=true)
public static Map<String, String> getContactDetails(Id contactId)

Retrieves the Account Id and Account Name for a given Contact. Used to auto-populate the Account when a Contact is selected.

Parameters:
    contactId – The Id of the Contact record.

Returns:
    Map<String, String>: Map with accountId and accountName keys.

private static Map<Id, PricebookEntry> getPricebookEntriesMap(
  Id pricebookId,
  Set<Id> productIds
)

Queries PricebookEntry records for a set of product Ids within a specific pricebook.

Parameters:
    pricebookId – The Pricebook2 Id.
    productIds – Set of Product2 Ids.

Returns:
    Map<Id, PricebookEntry>: Map keyed by Product2Id.

@AuraEnabled(cacheable=true)
public static QuoteBuilderController.ProductSearchResult getProductDetails(Id productId)

Retrieves product details and standard pricebook unit price for a given product Id. Called when a user selects a product via lightning-record-picker.

Parameters:
    productId – The Id of the Product2 record.

Returns:
    ProductSearchResult: Product details with pricing information.

private static String getProductNames(List<QuoteLineItem> items)

Retrieves product names for the given line items and returns them as a comma-separated string.

Parameters:
    items – The list of QuoteLineItem records containing Product2Id references

Returns:
    String: Comma-separated product names, or empty string if no products found

@AuraEnabled(cacheable=true)
public static List<Map<String, String>> getQuoteStatuses()

Returns the picklist values for the Quote.Status field.

Returns:
    List<Map<String, String>>: List of maps with label and value keys.

@AuraEnabled
public static Id saveQuote(
  String quoteJson,
  String lineItemsJson

Parameters:

    lineItemsJson – JSON string representing the list of line item data.

Returns:
